stabilization_criterion.ring: B=specified family algebra/full ordinary pure ideal;K_N full ordinary cutoff ideal modulo pure equations,j radical safe ideal
stabilization_criterion.equivalent: K_N stabilizes iff j^L stabilizes iff V(j) is open and closed iff all safe points over all Q-algebras share one cutoff iff safe functor has a closed representative in Spec(B)
stabilization_criterion.stable_ideal: A finitely generated idempotent ideal(e);the representative keeps all nilpotents on its open-and-closed safe component
stabilization_criterion.countercontrol: Restrict a retained failure scale to e^2=e:its cutoff ideals stabilize at(e) although the e=1 component remains a field failure;connectedness is essential

positive_ordinary_certificate.hypothesis: All pure field points in the family are safe with supplied common field cutoffC
positive_ordinary_certificate.conclusion: Let nu satisfy J^nu subset H+I_pure.Then I_N=I_pure in the family algebra for N>=C+(CD+1)(q*nu-1)
positive_ordinary_certificate.rings: Every pure-null point over every Q-algebra is safe with one bound independent of the target nilradical/length
positive_ordinary_certificate.effectivity: Full ordinary pure/cutoff ideals,nu,sufficient pure prefix andleast all-ring integer cutoff are theoretically computable by retained algorithms;none of the universal ternary/quadratic ideals or indices is computed

universal_cone_dichotomy.connectedness: Universal pure ideals are homogeneous in phase coefficients for Gaussian/SIC and bihomogeneous(m,m) for GVC;the nonnegative graded quotient with degree-zero Q has no nontrivial idempotents and contains the safe origin
universal_cone_dichotomy.equivalence: Fixed-size positive field assertion iff all-Q-algebra assertion iff ordinary cutoff stabilization iff eventual equality with the pure ideal iff one bound for all safe ring points iff a closed safe subfunctor
universal_cone_dichotomy.negative: A fixed-size field failure excludes stabilization and any thickness-free all-nonreduced uniform bound;this does not decide an open field-positive size
